name: Greatmother Hawkwind
summary: Beside the well on Red Cloud Mesa, Greatmother Hawkwind guides young tauren. As mother of Chief Hawkwind, Camp Narache's leader, she holds to the tribe's shared duty despite her age.

sections.title: Elder of the Mesa
sections.body: Greatmother Hawkwind spends her days beside Camp Narache's fresh water well, guiding young tauren as they begin their rites of passage. Age has slowed her stride, but she still takes part in village life. She believes every member of the tribe, young or old, must help sustain the community. She often asks young tauren to fetch water and help with simple chores.

sections.title: A Mother's Guidance
sections.body: Greatmother Hawkwind is mother to Chief Hawkwind, who leads Camp Narache. She offers counsel as threats face Red Cloud Mesa. Her son organizes hunters and warriors against Bristleback quilboar and local predators. She tends to the settlement's moral heart, reminding the newly awakened that strength begins with humility and service to kin.

faq.answer: Greatmother Hawkwind is an elderly tauren matriarch at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. She is the mother of Chief Hawkwind and guides young tauren.
She sits beside the water well southeast of Camp Narache, on Red Cloud Mesa in southwestern Mulgore.

faq.q: What tasks does she ask of young tauren?
faq.answer: Greatmother Hawkwind asks young tauren to gather water from the village well and deliver it to others in the camp. The chore teaches that no task is beneath a true servant of the tribe.

faq.q: What is her relation to Chief Hawkwind?
aliases: is she related to chief hawkwind
faq.answer: Greatmother Hawkwind is the mother of Chief Hawkwind, who oversees the defense and training of young braves at Camp Narache.

angles.text: As a young tauren beginning your journey on Red Cloud Mesa, you can see the Earth Mother's values in Greatmother Hawkwind: respect for elders, solidarity with your community, and humble service.
